claims.claim: Heidi Klum wore a giant severed hand costume at her New York Halloween party on 31 October 2026
claims.note: Both pages describe a giant severed hand worn at the annual party in New York, dated October 31.

claims.claim: The costume re-created her own left hand, with only her eyes and mouth showing
claims.note: CBS says she was unrecognizable with only eyes and mouth visible; E! describes a re-creation of her left hand.

claims.claim: In a September People interview she said the look would be very, very bloody and go well with red wine
claims.note: HollywoodLife quotes the September People interview for both phrases.

claims.claim: Born 1 June 1973 in Bergisch Gladbach, North Rhine-Westphalia
claims.note: Biography.com and Wikidata both give 1 June 1973 and Bergisch Gladbach.

claims.claim: Wikidata lists citizenship of Germany and the United States
claims.note: Wikidata lists Germany and United States as countries of citizenship.

claims.claim: She began modelling at 18 after winning a contest in Germany
claims.note: Biography.com: she started her modeling career at 18 after winning a contest in Germany.

claims.claim: In 1992 she won Model '92, a German TV contest on Thomas Gottschalk's talk show
claims.note: Abendzeitung lists Model '92 (1992) as a show where she was a contestant on Gottschalk's talk show.

claims.claim: 1998 Sports Illustrated swimsuit issue cover; Blow Dry (2001); Ella Enchanted (2004)
claims.note: Biography.com gives all three.

claims.claim: Project Runway premiered in December 2004; she hosted 16 seasons and announced her exit in September 2018
claims.note: Biography.com gives the December 2004 premiere, 16 seasons and September 2018 announcement.

claims.claim: Klum was one of eleven producers and worked as host and head judge of Project Runway
claims.note: Abendzeitung: one of eleven producers, Moderatorin and Jury-Vorsitzende.

claims.claim: She hosted Germany's Next Topmodel, launched on ProSieben in 2006
claims.note: Abendzeitung gives the start on ProSieben from 2006 and her hosting role; Biography.com says she began hosting after Project Runway launched.

claims.claim: Queen of Drags launched in Germany in 2019, a search for the most talented drag queen
claims.note: Abendzeitung: a new show in Germany started in 2019, searching for a drag queen.

claims.claim: She was announced as an America's Got Talent judge in March 2013 and left after six seasons
claims.note: Biography.com gives the March 2013 announcement and six seasons.

claims.claim: She returned to the jury of America's Got Talent: The Champions
claims.note: Abendzeitung says she returned to the judges' chair of the spin-off.

claims.claim: In March 2020 she teamed with Tim Gunn for the debut of Amazon's Making the Cut
claims.note: Biography.com gives the March 2020 debut with Gunn; Abendzeitung says the pair search for a global fashion label.

claims.claim: Six Emmy nominations in Outstanding Host for a Reality or Reality-Competition Program, 2013 to 2018, and one win in 2013
claims.note: Television Academy lists six nominations 2013-2018 and one win in 2013 in this category.

claims.claim: In October 2014 Bendon named her face and creative director of its flagship intimates collection, to be renamed Heidi Klum Intimates from 1 January 2015
claims.note: Bendon's release dated October 17, 2014 gives both points.

claims.claim: A costume jewelry line, Wildlife by Heidi Klum, was set to debut on QVC on 8 September, priced from $30 to $200
claims.note: TV Guide article dated June 29, 2011 gives the QVC date and the price range.

claims.claim: On & Off the Catwalk aired on ProSieben and Joyn on Sundays at 20:15 on 22 February and 1 March 2026
claims.note: Joyn page: airs 22 February and 1 March on Sundays at 20:15 on ProSieben and Joyn.

claims.claim: The series follows Klum and her children Leni and Henry through their modelling jobs
claims.note: Joyn page says the series follows Klum and her children in modelling jobs around the world.

claims.claim: The first episode runs 92 minutes
claims.note: Joyn episode page lists 92 Min.

claims.claim: The documentary had been planned as a two-part primetime show for spring 2026
claims.note: blue News: two-part primetime documentary set for spring 2026.

claims.claim: The 2026 party was her 25th annual Halloween party, held at Cathédrale in New York, and was presented by Apothic and Butterfinger
claims.note: Photo captions give the 25th annual party at Cathédrale on October 31, 2026; E! names Apothic and Butterfinger as presenters.

claims.claim: Getting into the costume took five to six hours and she said it was quite heavy
claims.note: CBS: five to six hours to get into the costume and It's quite heavy.

claims.claim: Her 2025 Medusa costume was hand-painted with about 15 people working on it
claims.note: E! says everything was hand-painted and about 15 people worked on it.

claims.claim: Earlier costumes included Medusa, a peacock, an 8-foot Transformer, a Thriller werewolf and Kali, and the 2022 worm costume on a fishing line
claims.note: CBS lists those past costumes and the 2022 fishing-line entrance.

claims.claim: The 2025 party was held at the Hard Rock Hotel New York
claims.note: CBS photo caption: 24th annual party at the Hard Rock Hotel New York on October 31, 2025.

claims.note: E! lists these guest costumes.
